title: Intermediate server for intermediating federated learning, user device and system that includes them

pse.problem: Inefficient data sharing and model updating in federated learning due to the need for direct communication between user devices and central server
pse.solution_function: A relay server coordinates the exchange of global models between a central server and multiple user devices. It updates the global model based on local models generated by training the global model with individual data from each user device.
pse.solution_structure: The relay server includes a processor, a key manager (optional), a machine learning core (in some user devices), and memory for storing keys, models, and data. The system includes multiple user devices with processors, a machine learning core (if included), and memory.
pse.solution_implementation: The relay server receives the global model from the central server, updates it based on local models sent by user devices, and transmits the updated global model back to the user devices. User devices receive the global model, generate a local model using their individual data, encrypt/decrypt the global model and individual data based on whether a key manager is included in the machine learning core, and transmit the local model to the relay server.
pse.effect: Improved efficiency in data sharing and model updating by minimizing direct communication between user devices and central server, thus reducing network traffic and potential privacy risks
